# RI Software

> RI Software is a small, senior software studio founded in 2019 by Danish Salman
> and Ahmed Saleem. We design and build web platforms, mobile apps, and AI
> automation — two founders on every project, weekly demos, and fixed scope.

## About

- Two-person studio; both founders work directly on every engagement, start to finish.
- Focused workload: a small number of projects at a time so each gets senior attention.
- Weekly demos of running software so clients always see where the work stands.

## Services

- Web platforms — custom web application development.
- Mobile apps — iOS and Android.
- AI automation — workflow and process automation.
- Product & design — from rough idea or finished spec through to shipped product.

- [Home](https://ri-software-agency.vercel.app/): studio overview and selected work.

- [Contact](https://ri-software-agency.vercel.app/contact): start a build or ask a question.
